Visualization

Load dataset

my_data <- readr::read_csv('D:/climetr/climetr_analysis/datasets/birjand_clean_dataset.csv')

Visualization temperature

my_data %>% ggplot() +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x=full_date, y=temp_air_mean_c)) +
   geom_smooth(mapping = aes(x=full_date, y=temp_air_mean_c)) +
  labs(title = "Temperature of 2013-2025")
## `geom_smooth()` using method = 'gam' and formula = 'y ~ s(x, bs = "cs")'

my_data %>% filter(year == selected_year) %>% ggplot() +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x=full_date, y=temp_air_mean_c)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(my_data, year == selected_year & is_ramadan == TRUE), mapping = aes(x=full_date, y=temp_air_mean_c), color="red") +
  labs(title = paste("Temperature of", selected_year), subtitle = "The red part is ramadan")

Visualization of Rolling Statistics & Anomalies

my_data %>% filter(year == selected_year) %>% ggplot() +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x=full_date, y=rolling_avg_7)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(my_data, year == selected_year & is_ramadan == TRUE), mapping = aes(x=full_date, y=rolling_avg_7), color="red") +
  labs(title = paste("Rolling average(7-days)", selected_year), subtitle = "The red part is ramadan")

my_data %>% filter(year == selected_year) %>% ggplot() +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x=full_date, y=rolling_avg_30)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(my_data, year == selected_year & is_ramadan == TRUE), mapping = aes(x=full_date, y=rolling_avg_30), color="red") +
  labs(title = paste("Rolling average(30-days)", selected_year), subtitle = "The red part is ramadan")

geoms <- c()
colorID = 47;
start_date = 2024
end_date = 2025
all_colors = colors()
for (ith_year in start_date:end_date) {
  geoms <- c(geoms, 
    # geom_line(mapping = aes(x=day_of_year, y=temp_air_mean_c)), 
    # geom_line(data = filter(my_data, year == selected_year & is_ramadan == TRUE), mapping = aes(x=day_of_year, y=temp_air_mean_c), color="red"),
    
    geom_line(data = filter(my_data, year == ith_year), mapping = aes(x=day_of_year, y=temp_air_mean_c), color=all_colors[colorID]),
    geom_line(data = filter(my_data, year == ith_year & is_ramadan == TRUE), mapping = aes(x=day_of_year, y=temp_air_mean_c), color=all_colors[colorID+4])
    )
  colorID <- colorID + 5;
}

my_data %>% filter(year == selected_year) %>% ggplot() +
  geoms +
  labs(title = paste0("Temperature of ", start_date, "-", end_date), subtitle = "Dark section of line is Ramadan")

Other visualizations

now we compare average temperature of 2013-2015 holy month of Ramadan to past year in that period.

top_padding =  0.2
start_date = 2014
end_date = 2025
plots <- c()

for (ith_year in end_date:(start_date + 1)) {
  ramadan_data <- my_data %>% filter(year == ith_year & is_ramadan == TRUE) %>% select(day_of_year, full_date, rolling_avg_30)
  last_day_index <- which.max(ramadan_data$day_of_year)
  last_day_doy <- ramadan_data$day_of_year[last_day_index]
  last_day_date <- ramadan_data$full_date[last_day_index]
  ramadan_temperature <- ramadan_data$rolling_avg_30[last_day_index]
  
  print(paste0("date: ", last_day_date, ", temperature: ", ramadan_temperature, ", DOY: ", last_day_doy))
  
  data <- my_data %>% filter(day_of_year == last_day_doy & year >= start_date & year <= ith_year) %>% select(day_of_year, full_date, year, rolling_avg_30)
  
  the_plot <- data %>%  ggplot() +
    geom_point(mapping = aes(x=full_date, y=rolling_avg_30), color = "blue") +
    labs(title=paste0("Rolling average 30-days of last day of Ramadan ", ith_year, " campare to past"), subtitle = paste0("Comparing average temperature of Ramadan of ", ith_year, " to ", day(last_day_date), " of ", month(last_day_date, label = T, abbr = F), " on the past.")) +
    annotate("text", x = last_day_date, y = ramadan_temperature, label="x", color = "red") +
     scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "12 month",
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +
   scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-40, 40)) +
   theme(
  plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
)
  
  # Add values labels
  for (idx in 1:nrow(data)) {
    the_plot <- the_plot + annotate("text", x = data[[idx, "full_date"]], y = data[[idx, "rolling_avg_30"]] + top_padding, label=paste(round(data[[idx, "rolling_avg_30"]], 2)), angle=0)
    }

  # Add average line + label for value of it
  mean_rolling_avg = mean(data$rolling_avg_30)
  the_plot <- the_plot +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = mean_rolling_avg,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "darkgreen",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
     annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(data$full_date),
    y = mean_rolling_avg + top_padding,
    label = paste0("Mean = ", round(mean_rolling_avg, 2)),
    color = "darkgreen",
    hjust = 1
  )

  # +
  #   annotate("text", x = dates[ceiling(length(dates)/2)], y = mean_rolling_avg + top_padding, label="salam")
  
  plots <- c(plots, the_plot)
}
